description:
The FreedomPay Commerce Platform is the technology of choice for many of the largest companies across the globe in retail, hospitality, lodging, gaming, sports and entertainment, foodservice, education, healthcare and financial services.  FreedomPay’s technology has been purposely built to deliver rock solid performance in the highly complex environment of global commerce. The company maintains a world-class security environment and was first to earn the coveted validation by the PCI Security Standards Council against Point-to-Point Encryption with EMV standard in North America. FreedomPay’s robust solutions across payments, security, identity and data analytics are available in-store, online and on-mobile and are supported by rapid API adoption. The award winning FreedomPay Commerce Platform operates on a single, unified technology stack across multiple continents allowing enterprises to deliver a consistent, repeatable experience on a global scale.  FreedomPay is a fast paced, high growth company with a great culture with competitive benefits and compensation with a business casual atmosphere.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to own payments data products, both existing products and new ones built from zero to one. You will decide what we build, why it matters to customers, and how it works.

This role runs on an AI-native workflow. You will use AI throughout how you research, define, and specify products, and you own the quality of the result.

You will also own products in FreedomPay's data and AI portfolio, including business intelligence, embedded reporting, outbound data feeds, and AI-powered features on our commerce data platform. You come in knowing how acquirers move, settle, and account for payments, and you are hands-on with data. You can take messy third-party feeds, map them to a clean model, and write the spec that engineering builds from. Experience at an acquirer is a big plus.

This is a product ownership role, not a project management role. You will make the technical and product decisions and see them through to customer results.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own specific product lines, features, or datasets within a defined domain.
  • Own data products across their lifecycle, from improving existing products to launching new ones from zero to one. Set the strategy, define the first release of each new product, and build the roadmap.
  • Define product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle across data and AI-driven products.
  • Validate incoming requests from sales, engineering, and customers, and separate real problems from noise.
  • Partner directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand their needs, constraints, and use cases.
  • Apply your payments and acquiring experience to decide what customers need and what is operationally realistic.
  • Define how third-party data is ingested, mapped to FreedomPay's data model, and normalized, so that data from many sources is consistent and usable.
  • Write mapping specifications that cover field-level transformations, handling of missing or inconsistent values, and rules for resolving conflicts between sources.
  • Work in an AI-native workflow. Use AI throughout the product process, and make sure what it produces is accurate, complete, and usable.
  • Translate complex business problems into structured workflows, data models, and decision logic.
  • Write implementation-ready product specifications, including requirements, data contracts, and acceptance criteria.
  • Make sure requirements reflect system architecture, dependencies, integrations, and real-world constraints, including the behavior of payment data from acquirers, processors, and card networks.
  • Take part in architecture and design discussions and make informed technical tradeoffs.
  • Own embedded BI and reporting capabilities, outbound data feeds, and AI augmented workflows and interfaces. Make sure dashboards, feeds, and data products are accurate, fast, and useful.
  • Ensure strong data governance, including consistent meaning of data, data quality, and reliability across product surfaces.
  • Work closely with engineering, data, and business teams to deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Stay involved during execution to answer questions, guide decisions, and keep the work aligned with product intent.
  • Use production feedback and customer insights to shape future iterations

    • Required Qualifications

  • 8 - 10+ years of experience in product management, or equivalent experience in engineering, data, or analytics roles.
  • Deep background in payments, with a focus on the acquiring side. You understand the payment lifecycle from authorization through clearing, settlement, and funding, and you know how acquirers, processors, and card networks exchange data.
  • Deep expertise in data mapping. You have ingested data from third-party sources, such as settlement files, card network reports, and processor data feeds. You have mapped it to a target data model and normalized it across sources with different formats, field definitions, and data quality problems.
  • Experience working directly with third-party data providers to agree on service level agreements (SLAs), error handling, and other operating terms, such as delivery schedules and how issues are escalated and fixed.
  • Strong technical background, including the ability to understand system architecture, APIs, and integrations.
  • Proficiency in SQL, and the ability to work directly with data models, schemas, and table-level structures. You can inspect source data and check that mappings are correct.
  • Experience building or shipping data products, analytics platforms, BI and reporting solutions, or data feeds.
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms (such as Snowflake) and BI tools (such as Sigma).
  • Experience with data governance, semantic modeling, and data quality frameworks, and an understanding of how they support AI products (semantics and grounding).
  • Experience using Claude Code or similar AI tools in your day-to-day product work.
  • Proven ability to turn customer and business needs into clear, actionable product requirements.
  • Strong ability to find gaps, edge cases, and risks in product or technical designs.
  • Experience working closely with engineering and data teams on technical or platform-based products, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without owning delivery execution.
  • Experience working with customers and partners in a technical capacity, including supporting complex integrations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to make and own decisions in a high-autonomy environment.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior work at an acquirer, processor, or payment facilitator.
  • Experience launching a new product or service from scratch, including defining it before a team or customer base existed.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks or orchestration tools (such as LangChain or similar).
    • As the fastest growing commerce company in the industry, we offer the opportunity for tremendous upward mobility within the company as well as development and professional growth opportunities. FreedomPay's fulltime roles provide exceptional benefits including medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, Life Insurance, Retirement Plans with company match, commission sharing plan, flexible hybrid working environment, and great parental and other leave programs. All positions must be able to successfully pass a background check as well as a credit check.
     
    FreedomPay is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
